source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Central Electricity Authority (CEA)
guidelines_title: MNRE Standard Guidelines & Techno-Economic Siting Benchmarks

onshore_wind_hectares_per_mw.recommended_spacing: 5 to 7 rotor diameters downwind, 3 to 5 crosswind

green_energy_corridor.ists_waiver: Inter-State Transmission System (ISTS) charges waived for solar and wind projects commissioned prior to June 2025 (gradual tapering).

environmental_clearance_regime.solar_wind_eia_status: Solar PV and Wind projects are exempt from MoEFCC Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) clearance, subject to Forest Clearance if applicable.
environmental_clearance_regime.great_indian_bustard_priority_zone: Mandatory undergrounding of 33kV lines and installation of bird diverters in Thar / Kutch priority habitats per Supreme Court / MNRE orders.
